tools.name: promote_post_with_paid_boost
tools.description: Moves a published post into the featured section of the site and pays for a sponsored boost on the ad platform for that post. The boost budget is charged to the blog's ad account.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post to feature and boost

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import tool

DB_PATH = "cms.db"


@dataclass
class BoostResult:
    post_id: int
    section: str
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int


@tool
def promote_post_with_paid_boost(post_id: int, budget_cents: int) -> BoostResult:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE posts SET section = 'featured' WHERE id = ?", (post_id,))
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=budget_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer="cus_blog_ads_account",
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"post_id": str(post_id), "purpose": "post_boost"},
    )
    return BoostResult(post_id, "featured", charge.id, budget_cents)

tools.name: import_markdown_batch_and_rebuild
tools.description: Moves markdown files from an inbox folder into the site's content directory, then runs the static site build command to regenerate the site. Returns the files moved and the build outcome.

params.name: inbox_dir
params.description: Folder containing markdown drafts to import

params.name: content_dir
params.description: Destination content folder of the site

tools.code:
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def import_markdown_batch_and_rebuild(inbox_dir: str, content_dir: str, build_command: str = "hugo --minify") -> dict:
    inbox = Path(inbox_dir)
    dest = Path(content_dir)
    result = {
        "moved": [],
        "skipped": [],
        "build": None,
        "error": None,
    }
    if not inbox.is_dir():
        result["error"] = f"inbox not found: {inbox_dir}"
        return result
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for md_file in sorted(inbox.glob("*.md")):
        target = dest / md_file.name
        if target.exists():
            result["skipped"].append(md_file.name)
            continue
        shutil.move(str(md_file), str(target))
        result["moved"].append(md_file.name)
    if not result["moved"]:
        result["error"] = "no files imported, build not run"
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run(
        shlex.split(build_command),
        cwd=str(dest.parent),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    result["build"] = {
        "returncode": proc.returncode,
        "stdout_tail": proc.stdout[-500:],
        "stderr_tail": proc.stderr[-500:],
    }
    result["success"] = proc.returncode == 0
    return result

tools.name: delete_post_and_notify_subscribers
tools.description: Permanently deletes a post and its comments from the CMS, then sends a takedown notice to the newsletter service's webhook so subscribers are told the post was removed.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post to delete

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason shown in the takedown notice

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import requests
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "cms.db"
WEBHOOK_URL = "https://newsletter.internal.example.com/hooks/takedown"


@function_tool
def delete_post_and_notify_subscribers(post_id: int, reason: str) -> str:
    if post_id <= 0:
        return "error: post_id must be positive"
    if not reason.strip():
        return "error: reason is required"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT title FROM posts WHERE id = ?", (post_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return f"error: post {post_id} not found"
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM comments WHERE post_id = ?", (post_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?", (post_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={"title": row[0], "reason": reason}, timeout=10)
    return f"deleted post {post_id}; notice status {resp.status_code}"
